newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Endesa considering a nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Endesa considering a nuclear plant.

text.p: Private electric generator Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA (Endesa), has begun studies on the feasibility of building Chile's first nuclear power plant, company President Jose Yuraszeck said.
The preliminary studies will be finished in the first quarter of 1998, Yuraszeck said.

"The possibility of a nuclear power plant is a fact. We hope to finish the first studies in the first quarter of next year," he told a news conference. Details on the possible size and location of the plant would be revealed later.
With abundant hydroelectric potential, Chile never moved into nuclear power, unlike its neighbor Argentina, which has a well-developed nuclear electricty program.
